note: Apollo Tyres reports three geographic segments (Ind AS 108): APMEA (India plus UAE, Thailand, Malaysia, South Africa), Europe (Apollo Vredestein manufacturing and sales: Netherlands and Hungary plants; ReifenCom distribution) and Others (Americas sales and corporate entities). Revenue = external revenue (after inter-segment eliminations, so the three sum to consolidated revenue). EBIT = segment result as reported (profit before interest, exceptional items, JV share and tax; it INCLUDES other income). EBITDA = segment result + segment depreciation. The sum of segment EBITDA therefore equals consolidated EBITDA plus other income. Rs crore. Annual: consolidated segment notes, AR FY21 (FY20-21), AR FY22 (FY21-22), AR FY24 (FY23-24), AR FY26 (FY25-26). Quarterly: company KPIs from the earnings presentations (India = standalone; Europe = manufacturing and sales operations excluding ReifenCom, EUR mn) and consolidated P&L.

_annualNotes.exceptional: Consolidated exceptional items before tax (+ = charge). FY21 Rs608 cr (mainly the Europe restructuring, segment note AR FY21: Europe Rs596 cr); FY24 Rs77 cr; FY25 Rs169 cr (Enschede impairment Rs128 cr, VRS Rs26 cr, Trusted Mobility closure Rs25 cr, less Rs10 cr IL&FS recovery); FY26 Rs1,034 cr (Enschede restructuring and impairment Rs1,000 cr, labour codes Rs26 cr, VRS Rs7 cr). FY22 Rs6 cr, FY23 a Rs23 cr gain, FY24 Rs77 cr: segment notes (AR FY22, AR FY24). MOSL's adjusted-PAT table (7-Aug-2026) removes larger amounts for FY21 (Rs493 cr) and FY24 (Rs179 cr) and also strips the FY26 deferred-tax write-back; we use MOSL's adjusted EPS for the one-off-free P/E history (see company.json adjEps).
_annualNotes.capex: Segment capital expenditure (AR FY24 and AR FY26 segment notes); FY26 total Rs1,504 cr on the segment basis.
_annualNotes.india: Standalone (India operations) revenue and EBITDA, Q4FY26 presentation (FY26 Rs19,816 cr, 14.5%; FY25 Rs18,174 cr, 12.1%).
_annualNotes.europe: Europe manufacturing and sales operations excluding ReifenCom (EUR mn), presentations; FY25 margin is the revenue-weighted quarterly average (GAM calculation).

_quarterlyNotes: Presentations Q1FY26 (Aug-2025), Q2FY26 (Nov-2025), Q3FY26 (Feb-2026), Q4FY26 (May-2026), Q1FY27 (7-Aug-2026); prior-year quarters from the comparative columns. Exceptional items before tax (+ = charge; Q1FY27 = Rs23.5 cr interim IL&FS recovery). PAT = Screener (as reported). Q4FY26 PAT includes a ~Rs570 cr deferred-tax write-back on moving to the 25% regime.
